changes.description: Reads points from a table a workflow computed, as geopandas' points_from_xy does. Connect a table to the new optional `records` input and name its x (longitude) and y (latitude) columns, and optionally a record ID and a label. Read as CRS84. A row whose coordinates are empty, not numbers or out of range is kept with no position and counted, never a refusal of the table; rows sharing a position are counted too, the sign that a table needs totalling to one row per place first. Every column travels as an attribute. Unconnected, the widget is the source it always was. The receipt states fw:PointsFromTable with the columns read and what was placed, written by src/table-points.ts and held by fw:PointsFromTableShape. The practitioner, 2026-11-05: 'Point data widget has input options that include CSV' -- so a source of this widget, and no new one. Experiment 178.
